data.summary: A focused and goal-oriented B.Tech Engineer professional with 7.5 years of organizational experience. Proficient in Data analytics, data tracing, data lineage, data governance, data management, data mining, and data operation. Performing data cleansing, data transformation of large data. A quick learner with the expertise to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Good technical, Communication and Interpersonal Skills with strong Client Interfacing Skills. Experience in the Global stakeholder management and internal stakeholder management.

responsibilities: Actively collaborating with subject matter experts (SMEs) within the business to understand the line of business processes, and systems of record.
Experienced in working as a Data Analyst and delivering the data lineage and maintenance process.
Managed data dictionaries, business glossaries, and metadata repositories.
Conducted data profiling to identify data quality issues and root causes.
Collaborated with data stewards and owners to drive data quality improvements.
Support identification and resolution of data lineage issues, supporting the analysis and creation of remediation plans in partnership with BAU teams.
Established data lineage and traceability for key business data flows.
Document banks data flow in line with the CDO methodology & framework.
Drawing/Creation, updating, deletion of the Data lineage. capturing and tracing the lineage end-to-end.
As CDO Data Analyst, making sure of Data Owner, Data Steward, CDE Owner, EUDA Owner, Application owner, Data Control Owner knows about the data they own.
Identify and capture the critical data element to make to maintain integrity of data.
On-boarding of Critical Data Elements with all information of CDE.
Working on annual attestation activity based on the scope of critical data elements, EUDA, Applications.
Working on large data concepts and data sourcing, data integration, data loading.

Identification of critical data elements in different systems. collaborating with senior stakeholders to identify the data lineage, data owners, establishing the data quality rules and maintain data quality.
Support in proper communication regarding metadata changes to customers.
Prepare reports, documents, metrics and presentations and exchange ideas/information in logical manner, Checking the data quality parameters.
Verify the documents & files and adding the data attributes into the tool and system.
Execution of material master data maintenance tasks with high quality and accuracy.
Working on the large materials and vendor details files and sorting the files and data cleansing activity.
Making the data visualization and Reports on the Excel and Power BI tools.
Good understanding and knowledge of Data governance tool.
collaborate and communicate frequently with Process Owners, Data Providers.
Managing supplier's database and master data management, uploading the large data and reports in the system.
Normalize the extracted data & update it in the client approved template.
Updating the logistics and vendor data in system.
Standardization of data definitions and ensuring consistency in measurement as per definitions across systems/products/regions.
Monitoring the large details for the inventory and planning reports and sending the reports and visualization to the customers and US team.
To meet or exceed desired service levels and inventory targets as defined for the products assigned, validated through procurement metrics.
Working on tableau dashboard and reports to analyze the inventory details.
Working with customers to complete the business plans and the future demand.
Working experience for the Global customer and US, Mexico, Canada, Asia Regions.

Proficient in Data analytics, data tracing, data lineage, data governance, data management, data mining,
Performing data cleansing, data transformation of large data.
A quick learner with the expertise to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Good technical, Communication and Interpersonal Skills with strong Client Interfacing Skills.
Experience in the Global stakeholder management and internal stakeholder management.
